## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Financials and Industrials showing ABOVE TREND leadership (JPM ABOVE TREND; CAT ABOVE TREND) and top performers include several Technology and Materials names ABOVE TREND (AMAT, INTC, AMD), Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5), Style: Value/Cyclical tilt.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Financials lead: JPM (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +7.78%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: CAT (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +14.61%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +0.49% | 1M: +3.59%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy weak: XOM (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -15.22%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -6.56% | 1M: -11.97%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare lagging: JNJ (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -0.13%) BELOW TREND, PFE (1W: -3.67% | 1M: -1.75%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +7.78%) ABOVE TREND, TTWO (1W: +12.83% | 1M: +0.48%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +11.87% | 1M: +21.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +51.85%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) indicates healthy participation.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: COP (1W: -7.26% | 1M: -10.70%) BELOW TREND, VLO (1W: -7.55% | 1M: -9.59%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -7.80% | 1M: -6.67%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -15.19%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -9.28% | 1M: -11.42%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Energy and select high-multiple Tech names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +7.78%) ABOVE TREND, TTWO (1W: +12.83% | 1M: +0.48%) ABOVE TREND — note MAJOR divergence across large caps (multiple megacaps with 1W up vs 1M down), so treat moves as tactical momentum rather than full regime confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but constructive: AMAT (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +51.85%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +11.41% | 1M: +16.02%) ABOVE TREND versus MSFT (1W: -2.80% | 1M: -8.91%) BELOW TREND and ADBE (1W: -10.80% | 1M: -23.46%) BELOW TREND; sector showing internal rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Clear strength: JPM (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +7.78%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.57% | 1M: -0.81%) RECOVERY — breadth within Financials is supportive and confirms cyclical tilt.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Under pressure and mixed: JNJ (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -0.13%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -0.57% | 1M: +3.60%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -5.37% | 1M: +7.55%) CORRECTION — sector breadth lagging versus market.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials and Industrials exposure given ABOVE TREND leadership (JPM, CAT) and strong 1W momentum in cyclicals; reduce exposure to Energy and weak Tech laggards (ACN, ADBE) showing sustained BELOW TREND action. Monitor major-cap tech divergences (many 1W vs 1M mismatches) before increasing core Growth weight.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +51.85%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +7.78%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XOM (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -15.22%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -6.56% | 1M: -11.97%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -23.60% | 1M: -27.61%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Financials, Industrials, Materials (each showing ABOVE TREND leaders and momentum). BEARISH: Energy, Healthcare, Communication (lagging on 1W and 1M metrics).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch continuation signals: INTC sustaining >1W momentum and holding recent breakout to confirm ABOVE TREND follow-through; AMAT maintaining its multi-week strength to keep ABOVE TREND; MSFT needs to stop the 1W downtrend to avoid deeper BELOW TREND extension; XOM/CVX further weakness below last-week lows would reinforce sector BELOW TREND risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
INTC (+65): News on U.S. chip build partnerships; INTC (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by strong price action. TTWO (+55): GTA VI preorder catalyst; TTWO (1W: +12.83% | 1M: +0.48%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. JPM (+55): AI operational shift headlines; JPM (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment aligns with strength.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ACN (-50): Negative headlines and heavy selling; ACN (1W: -23.60% | 1M: -27.61%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. MSFT (-45): Office access headlines; MSFT (1W: -2.80% | 1M: -8.91%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. ADBE (noted weakness in flow): ADBE (1W: -10.80% | 1M: -23.46%) BELOW TREND — price action confirms negative tone.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with a Value/Cyclical tilt. INTC ABOVE TREND, AMAT ABOVE TREND and JPM ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Major divergence across large-cap Tech (many 1W up vs 1M down) and Energy weakness are key risks to monitor alongside mixed sentiment signals.
